title: Degraded but Not Entirely Ineffective: PE-Based Deformable Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.13712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world scenarios can be represented using graph-structured data. However, traditional GNNs that transmit messages based on first-order neighbors have long faced several fundamental contradictions: increasing depth leads to over-smoothing, long-range dependencies cause over-compression, fixed neighborhoods restrict the receptive field, and on heterophilous graphs, topological neighbors become a source of noise. Although many works have addressed these issues individually, few mechanisms can simultaneously alleviate all of these challenges. To address the aforementioned problems, we propose a Position Encoding-Based Deformable Spatial Aggregation Module (PEBDSAM) that solves them all in one step. Specifically, we utilize a deformable mechanism in the position space to identify relevant nodes to supplement the original first-order neighbor information of GNNs, allowing traditional GNNs to adapt to heterophilous scenarios. translated_title: 退化但并非完全失效：基于位置编码的可变形图神经网络
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的场景都可以用图结构数据来表示。然而，传统图神经网络基于一阶邻居进行消息传递，长期面临若干根本性矛盾：增加深度会导致过平滑，长距离依赖会导致过压缩，固定的邻域限制了感受野，而在异配图上，拓扑邻居反而会成为噪声来源。尽管已有许多工作单独解决了这些问题，但很少有机制能够同时缓解所有这些挑战。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了基于位置编码的可变形空间聚合模块（PEBDSAM），一步解决所有这些问题。具体而言，我们利用位置空间中的可变形机制来识别相关节点，以补充图神经网络原有的第一阶邻居信息，使传统图神经网络能够适应异配场景。通过……
tldr: 提出基于位置编码的可变形空间聚合模块（PEBDSAM），通过在位置空间中利用可变形机制识别相关节点来补充一阶邻居信息，同时缓解传统图神经网络的过平滑、过压缩、感受野受限和异配图噪声等多个核心难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Position Encoding-Based Deformable Spatial Aggregation Module (PEBDSAM) that uses a deformable mechanism in position space to identify relevant nodes and supplement first-order neighbor information, simultaneously alleviating over-smoothing, over-compression, restricted receptive fields, and noise on heterophilous graphs in traditional GNNs.
